principles: One catalogue truth — etl_* / products-with-grants* / sustainable catalog; no forked product JSON for Agent Market
Deep-dive architecture for browse & compare — not a second full Wix shop UI inside every agent
Same content-module shell as story chips and agent tablets — chat stays behind
Agents advise; Market completes the closed loop (browse → decide → shortlist → buy handoff)
Purchase stays on real marketplace / Wix until phase 4 — Agent Market does not invent checkout
Grants, projection, and finance tablets stay one click from any product card
Fail open: works without member login; personalise later via shortlist + profile

userStories.title: Agent Market HTML shell + route
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want an Agent Market page I can open in the same in-panel module as other portal tools.
acceptanceCriteria: HTML at HTMLS GWM GWB/greenways-agent-market.html
Route GET /greenways/agent-market (and static under HTMLS GWM GWB)
Wix no-scroll meta; overflow-x hidden; works desktop and mobile
Hero + lane strip placeholders; no fake products
Registered in data/greenways-content-modules.json as id agent-market

userStories.title: Open from story + agent sidebars
userStories.description: As a visitor on the agents story or an agent chat, I want one click to preview Agent Market in the module shell.
acceptanceCriteria: greenways-agents-story.html tool chip or fifth chip opens data-module-open=agent-market
Artemis and Zyanne quick links include Agent Market (moduleOpen)
Module cover returnLabel works (Back to story / Back to Artemis)
Does not change existing marketplace-home module behaviour

userStories.title: Curated product rails with grants chips
userStories.description: As a buyer, I want to browse a short curated set of marketplace products with grant context, not a blank shop.
acceptanceCriteria: data/agent-market-showcase.json lists etl_* ids by lane (min 3 lanes, ≥3 products each)
Cards load grant counts/names from products-with-grants* by id (same overlay as deep dive)
Open detail uses root-relative /product-page-v2-marketplace.html?product=…&fromPopup=true
Broken/missing product ids skip gracefully (no empty broken cards)

userStories.title: Deep-dive style compare affordance
userStories.description: As a buyer, I want a familiar compare path from Agent Market into equipment deep dive or savings projection.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card can open equipment-deep-dive or savings-projection via ContentModule (moduleOpen) or in-page CTA
Copy uses equipment not kit
Lane HVAC can deep-link marketplace-hvac module as story context

userStories.title: Shortlist from Agent Market
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to save products and return to an agent without losing my shortlist.
acceptanceCriteria: Save writes greenways-product-shortlist in sessionStorage (same key Customer Hub expects)
Footer shows shortlist count; empty state explains Save
Ask Artemis / Ask Vincent CTA opens /greenways/{agent}?q= with product name or id hint
Works without login

userStories.title: Buy on Greenways Market handoff
userStories.description: As a buyer ready to purchase, I want a clear path to the real marketplace product page (and later Wix cart), not a fake checkout in the agent.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary buy CTA labels Buy on Greenways Market (or Open product page)
Opens marketplace product URL in new tab or fullPageHref from module chrome
No payment forms inside Agent Market v1
Optional later: Wix cart deep-link documented as AM-007 backlog when APIs ready

successMetrics: Story + Artemis/Zyanne can open Agent Market without console errors
≥9 curated products render with grants chips on Render
Shortlist survives navigation back to agent chat in same tab
Buy CTA lands on live product page for a known etl_* id (e.g. Ecostore fridge)
